fields.role: The job title or function of the person associated with the record.
fields.operational_phase: The specific stage of plant operation.
fields.access_level: The degree of physical or system access permitted.
fields.rule: The narrative statement of a conditional operational rule.
fields.parameter: The name of the operational variable being monitored.
fields.target: The desired or ideal value for a parameter.
fields.threshold: The value at which a specific response is triggered.
fields.response: The system alert or trip action resulting from a threshold breach.
fields.ro_feed_stream: The identifier for the reverse osmosis feed stream.
fields.parameter_tag: The unique instrument tag associated with a parameter.
fields.measurement: The type of physical property being measured.
fields.metric_unit: The unit of measure for the recorded value.
fields.min_bound: The lower limit of an acceptable range.
fields.max_bound: The upper limit of an acceptable range.
fields.required_correction: The manual action required to return a parameter to range.
fields.time_allowance: The duration permitted to resolve an issue or perform a task.
fields.requirement: A mandatory operational or safety instruction.
fields.regulatory_compliance: The specific legal or regulatory mandate to be followed.
fields.trigger: The narrative condition that initiates a specific action.
fields.action: The required response or procedure following a trigger.

categories.AccessConstraint: Constraints regarding physical or system access.
categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions taken in response to a specific event or threshold.
categories.SequencingRequirement: Requirements regarding the order of operations.
categories.DisposalProcedure: Instructions for the disposal of materials.
categories.DataRetentionRequirement: Rules regarding the storage of records.
categories.DiagnosticProcedure: Steps for troubleshooting or analyzing equipment.
